import sys
from collections import defaultdict

MOD = 1000000007
INV = 570000004

def add_mod(a, b):
    s = a + b
    return s - MOD if s >= MOD else s

def sub_mod(a, b):
    s = a - b
    return s + MOD if s < 0 else s

def mul_mod(a, b):
    return (a * b) % MOD

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    # Initialize global variables
    index_map = {}
    node_count = 0
    timestamp = 0
    children = [[0]* (1 << n) for _ in range(65536)]
    p = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    q = [[1]*(1 << n) for _ in range(n)]
    dp = [[0]*(1 << n) for _ in range(n+1)]
    
    # Function to perform DFS
    def dfs(state):
        nonlocal index_map, timestamp
        state_tuple = tuple(state)
        if state_tuple in index_map:
            return index_map[state_tuple]
        current_id = timestamp
        timestamp += 1
        index_map[state_tuple] = current_id
        for mask in range(1 << node_count):
            new_state = state[:]
            for j in range(1 << node_count):
                if not new_state[j]:
                    k_mask = mask & j
                    k_mask_copy = k_mask
                    while k_mask_copy:
                        k_bit = k_mask_copy & -k_mask_copy
                        j_xor = j ^ k_bit
                        if state[j_xor]:
                            new_state[j] = 1
                            break
                        k_mask_copy ^= k_bit
            children[current_id][mask] = dfs(new_state)
        return current_id

    # Read n and initialize
    # The first input is n, already read
    # Read p matrix
    idx = 1
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            p[i][j] = int(input[idx])
            idx += 1
    # Convert p to probabilities
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            p[i][j] = mul_mod(p[i][j], INV)
    # Precompute q
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(1 << n):
            q[i][j] = 1
            for k in range(n):
                val = p[k][i] if (j >> k) & 1 else sub_mod(1, p[k][i])
                q[i][j] = mul_mod(q[i][j], val)
    # Run DFS to build the state space
    initial_state = [0]* (1 << n)
    initial_state[0] = 1
    root_id = dfs(initial_state)
    # Initialize DP
    dp[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(timestamp):
            for k in range(1 << n):
                next_state = children[j][k]
                dp[i + 1][next_state] = add_mod(dp[i + 1][next_state], mul_mod(dp[i][j], q[i][k]))
    # Final result
    res_state = [1]* (1 << n)
    res_tuple = tuple(res_state)
    res_id = index_map[res_tuple]
    print(dp[n][res_id])

main()
